items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon, first only to trusted cyber defenders
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布 Gemini 4 Argon，先僅開放給可信網安防守方
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model for long-horizon coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense. It is rolling out first through the Fairwind Program to trusted cyber defenders while Google takes part in the U.S. government’s voluntary pre-release access process; broader access is slated to start with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra. Official claims include a 1M output-token limit, DeepSWE v1.1 at 77.9%, introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens, and later list prices of $4/$20.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，主打長程軟體工程、企業知識工作與網安防禦。首波經 Fairwind Program 給可信網安防守方，並參與美國政府自願性預發布取用程序；較廣開放預計從付費 API 與 Google AI Ultra 開始。官方宣稱輸出上限 100 萬 token、DeepSWE v1.1 77.9%，導入價每百萬 token $2/$10，之後為 $4/$20。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first Google flagship named Gemini 4, and the gated cyber-first rollout is the product decision: capability is asserted, general availability is not. Benchmark leads and internal use cases are Google-reported; whether Argon ships broadly without another hold is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Google 首度以 Gemini 4 命名的旗艦，且採「先給防守方」分階段上線：能力有官方數字，普及時程沒有。基準與內部案例皆為 Google 自述，能否不再延後全面開放仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日宣布新的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，正透過 Fairwind Program 向一組可信網安防守方推出。

items_flat.title_en: FTC opens consumer-harm probe of OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs
items_flat.title_zh: FTC 對 OpenAI、Anthropic 等實驗室啟動消費危害調查
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, the New York Times, Bloomberg and the Washington Post reported that the U.S. FTC has opened a broad inquiry into whether OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI firms violated unfair-or-deceptive-practices law. Officials said the agency plans civil investigative demands and executive testimony, and named METR among parties that may receive process. Neither lab had an immediate public comment in those reports.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透、紐時、彭博與華郵報導，美國 FTC 已對 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他 AI 公司展開調查，檢視是否違反不公平或欺罔行為法。官員稱將發民事調查令並要求高階主管作證，METR 也可能被要求提供資料。上述報導中兩家實驗室皆尚未公開回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming a day after a penalty-free White House pledge, this is the first named Trump-era enforcement track on agent incidents—but it is still an investigation, not a complaint or finding. Scope beyond OpenAI, Anthropic and METR has not been published by the FTC itself.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 緊接在無罰則的白宮承諾之後，這是川普任內首個點名代理攻擊事件的執法軌跡——但仍是調查，不是起訴或結論。FTC 尚未自行公布調查範圍是否超出 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 METR。

items_flat.title_en: White House accord: labs pledge four-layer AI controls, no penalties named
items_flat.title_zh: 白宮協議：實驗室承諾四層 AI 管控，未列罰則
items_flat.summary_en: President Trump released a one-page White House Accord on Super Intelligence, also called the Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, signed with executives from Google (Sundar Pichai), Anthropic (Dario Amodei), Meta (Mark Zuckerberg), OpenAI (Greg Brockman), xAI/SpaceX (Elon Musk) and Nvidia (Jensen Huang). The text asks each firm for internal capability/alignment monitoring (including cyber and CBRN), an internal controls team, an independent external auditor or evaluator, and an independent board committee. Trump called it “morally binding”; press accounts say it names no penalties, deadlines, or duty to publish audits.
items_flat.summary_zh: 川普公布一頁《White House Accord on Super Intelligence》（亦稱 Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities），簽署者包括 Google 的 Sundar Pichai、Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei、Meta 的 Mark Zuckerberg、OpenAI 的 Greg Brockman、xAI/SpaceX 的 Elon Musk 與 Nvidia 的 Jensen Huang。文本要求內部能力／對齊監控（含網安與 CBRN）、內部管控團隊、獨立外部審計或評估，以及獨立董事會委員會。川普稱「道德上有約束力」；媒體指出未列罰則、期限或公開審計義務。
items_flat.analysis_en: This remains the first same-table written pledge covering the tracked U.S. frontier vendors after a week of agent-safety incidents. Product change is still undefined: who audits, what is published, and whether the FTC probe announced the next day treats the pledge as a defense or as evidence of claimed controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這仍是本週代理安全事件後，美國主要前沿廠商首次同桌書面承諾。產品層改變尚未定義：誰審計、公開什麼，以及隔日 FTC 調查會把這份承諾當抗辯還是當「已宣稱有管控」的證據。
items_flat.quote_zh: 我認為這在道德上有約束力。

items_flat.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini Skills globally; Gems to be retired
items_flat.title_zh: Google 全球推出 Gemini Skills，Gems 將退役
items_flat.summary_en: Google said Skills—reusable slash-command instructions already in Gemini Spark—are rolling out in Gemini chat globally and will come to Workspace in the coming weeks. Skills will replace Gems; personal-account Gems support ends starting November 2026, with later Workspace dates in 2027, and Gems will be auto-migrated. Google Labs’ Opal mini-app experiment will also shut down in November.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 宣布已在 Gemini Spark 提供的可重用斜線指令 Skills，即日起全球進入 Gemini 對話，並將於數週內進入 Workspace。Skills 將取代 Gems：個人帳號自 2026 年 11 月起停止支援，Workspace 則延至 2027 年，Gems 會自動遷移。Google Labs 的 Opal 小應用實驗也將於 11 月關閉。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a consumer-surface consolidation, not a frontier-model event. The uncertainty is operational: whether migrated Gems keep behavior and sharing, and whether Opal users get a replacement beyond Skills.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是消費端介面整合，不是前沿模型事件。不確定點在遷移後行為與分享是否完整，以及 Opal 使用者除 Skills 外有無替代。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re rolling out skills directly into Gemini chat globally, and bringing this functionality to Google Workspace business, enterprise, nonprofit, and education customers in the coming weeks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們即日起把 Skills 直接推進全球 Gemini 對話，並將在數週內提供給 Google Workspace 商業、企業、非營利與教育客戶。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI posts small-business agents report and ASBDC training partnership
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布中小企業代理報告並與 ASBDC 合作培訓
items_flat.summary_en: On X, OpenAI said a new report looks at how small businesses use AI agents for customers, products and finance, and that a partnership with the America’s SBDC network will add hands-on AI training and local guidance for owners.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 X 表示，新報告探討中小企業如何用 AI 代理處理客戶、產品與財務，並與 America’s SBDC 網絡合作，為業者提供實作培訓與在地指引。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and narrative after DevDay, not a new model. Impact depends on whether the training program actually reaches SBDC clients; that was not evidenced in the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 DevDay 後的通路與敘事，不是新模型。成效取決於培訓是否真正送到 SBDC 客戶，貼文本身未證明。
items_flat.quote: Small teams are taking on more with AI—from finding customers to building products and managing finances.
items_flat.quote_zh: 小型團隊正用 AI 承擔更多工作——從找客戶、做產品到管財務。
